summary: Frontend-only verification of Obserra brand consistency (auth + in-app) and role-aware Onboarding Tour with spotlight + replay. Uncovered 2 blocking runtime errors on /app/settings (missing lucide-react imports Compass & PlayCircle) which crashed the page and prevented the Replay tour test; both fixed. After fixes, all 6 requested checks PASS. Brand assets (brand-mark.png, brand-wordmark.png, brand-lockup.png) all serve 200, render on desktop (1400px) and mobile (390px) auth, and match inside the app shell.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKING: React runtime crash 'Compass is not defined' — <Compass/> icon used on line 62 was not imported from lucide-react. Entire Settings route rendered a red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay; Replay Tour button was unreachable.
BLOCKING: React runtime crash 'PlayCircle is not defined' — <PlayCircle/> icon used on line 66 (inside Replay tour button) was not imported. Same crash overlay as above.

issues: Wordmark under the eye mark renders at h-10 (~40px tall). User explicitly asked for the company name to be LARGE on the sign-in page. On desktop it is 80px (h-16 xl:h-20), which reads well, but the mobile variant looks small relative to the mark (mark 96px vs wordmark 40px). Consider bumping mobile wordmark to h-14 or h-16 for parity with the intent.

action_items: Consider enlarging the mobile wordmark on Auth (Auth.jsx line 68: h-10 → h-14/h-16) to match the 'name must be LARGE' requirement on small screens.
Add a bundler/lint safeguard (e.g., eslint no-undef) so missing lucide-react imports never ship as runtime crashes again — the two Settings icons were only caught during E2E.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx: two lucide icons (Compass, PlayCircle) were used without imports — indicates the file was edited without running a build/lint check. Enable react/jsx-no-undef in ESLint config to fail-fast at compile time.

OnboardingTour.jsx: spotlight uses fixed positioning + boxShadow 9999px trick which is correct; consider adding role='dialog' + aria-modal + aria-labelledby={tour-title} for a11y — currently the modal is not announced to screen readers.

OnboardingTour.jsx: clicking on the dimmed backdrop calls finish() which persists the done key. Users who click outside accidentally on step 1 will not see the tour again — consider closing without persisting on backdrop click, or removing the backdrop-click-to-close.
Auth.jsx mobile lockup: h-10 wordmark visually understates the brand next to h-24 mark; increase for visual weight the user asked for.

rca of the issue: Blocking Settings crash was a direct RCA: JSX referenced Compass and PlayCircle without importing them, causing a ReferenceError that React surfaces as a red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Reproduction: navigate to /app/settings while logged in (any role). Mitigation applied: added both symbols to the lucide-react import on line 5 of /app/frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx. Long-term mitigation: enable react/jsx-no-undef ESLint rule as an error (not warning) and add a CI check on frontend build.
